_doc: The site menu (todo-header-rebuild.md). Edit here, then run: python scripts/menu_build.py
That writes reports/assets/menu.js, which every page loads; no page needs rebuilding for a menu change.
state: visible (everyone) | hidden-dev (shown only with Dev view on; listed in the public menu.js) | hidden (left out of menu.js; direct link only).
Neither hidden state is secret: the repo and every built page are public.
aliases: other page keys (data-current) that highlight this tab. href '@awards' = the latest week's awards page.
rows: fixed sub-rows (a page asks for one with data-row). Data-driven rows (seasons, weeks, projection archive) are built from the pages in reports/.

tabs._note: Selection Watch Dev-only until approved. The master switch in SelectionWatch.json overrides this state.
